task: Review the fellowship_application.pdf to determine if the applicant meets the key school policy requirement that all fellowship applicants must have published at least one peer-reviewed journal article. If the applicant does not meet this requirement, create a document named evaluation_result.docx summarizing the finding, using the keywords: 'does not meet', 'publication', and 'policy'. Then email the evaluation_result.docx to officer@university.edu with the subject: Fellowship Application Evaluation - Alice Johnson.
query_sentence: Check if the application PDF satisfies the school's main policy for fellowship, summarize the result in a docx, and email the document to the officer.

ground_truth_memory.memory_item: School policy requires fellowship applicants to have at least one peer-reviewed journal publication.
The output document name must be evaluation_result.docx.
The email subject must be 'Fellowship Application Evaluation - Alice Johnson'.
The evaluation_result.docx must mention the applicant does not meet publication policy.
